ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (near-black) surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters occupying approximately <5% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes, interrupted by discrete, high-contrast circular white annuli scattered across the mid-to-distal regions of the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle, showing significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys are most prominent along the lateral distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions observed, including one diagonal streak on the upper-interior region of the right lobe and several horizontal micro-scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle detachment; significant irregular notch-like defects along the trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive contrast ratio between the near-zero intensity fluke body and the stark white circular scar patterns.
